Counts from this audit: 95 people; 48 included (30 regular, 18 joint_secondary, all current, no incoming); 47 excluded; 0 unresolved. Research-professor titles on the secondary list (Alles, Schilling, Smith, Yan) are excluded research_only per the brief, and secondary-list adjoint titles (Feldman) are excluded adjunct.

All six directory list pages were downloaded and fully enumerated (99 rows; 95 unique people after the four research/emeritus overlaps). Every brief person appears on at least one list and every list name maps to a brief person; no omissions.

Profile pages at engineering.vanderbilt.edu/bio/<slug> were fetched for 12 people (Fauchet, Biswas, Kuntz, Walker, Xiong, Cutting, Alles, Feldman, Davidson, Galloway, Kawamura, Weller). All 12 are the same site template with no person-specific title text, so profiles contributed no rank evidence; decisions rest on the directory list rows. Profile retrieval is info only per the brief.
No effective start dates or incoming appointments appear on any downloaded source; effective_from_json is null for all records.
Directory rows carry no start dates; no employment interval was inferred from capture times.
